counterfactual_text: The closed book opens while still resting on the shelf, then crosses the edge and falls to the floor.
positive_text: The closed book crosses the shelf edge, loses support, falls continuously, strikes the floor, and settles open.
semantic_text: A closed book is pushed past the edge of a shelf, falls, and lands open on the floor. Required visible entities: one closed book; one shelf with a visible edge; floor below the shelf. At the beginning: book: closed, intact, and fully supported near the shelf edge; floor: clear beneath the book. Required state changes: book support: shelf-supported to unsupported; book position: shelf to floor; book state: closed to open. These event variables are allowed to change: book position; book support state; book orientation and open-versus-closed state. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; shelf and floor geometry; book identity and cover appearance; one closed book at the start; one shelf and the floor below; the same book through the fall.
